children: Gen Digital outlined a disciplined M&A approach and said fiscal 2027 revenue growth is expected to be 9%–11% with mid‑to‑high‑teens non‑GAAP EPS growth.
CEO Vincent Pilette explained acquisition criteria: strategic fit, price, efficiencies, accretion, and comparison to buybacks.
Company cited past deals (Avast, MoneyLion) as examples of adding users, monetization and >30% ROIC for MoneyLion in year two.
Raised fiscal 2027 outlook to 9%–11% revenue growth and mid‑to‑high‑teens non‑GAAP EPS growth; quarter and year tracking to high end.
Stated transformation from ~$2B revenue and <$1 EPS six years ago to >$5B revenue and nearly $3 EPS today, emphasizing AI and technology investments.

title: Gen Digital CEO outlines disciplined acquisition strategy, raises fiscal 2027 outlook to 9%-11% revenue growth
